title: PowerPoint on the web: Copilot agent notifies you when work is complete or needs attention
summary: The roadmap facts and the existing licence controls are supported. The page incorrectly says no rollout mechanism is stated: Microsoft's cited release notes describe gradual deployment of Copilot features within tenants, although the rollout window for these notifications remains unpublished.

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance guidance: Before rollout; Governance controls table
claims.claim: User licence assignment is available at Microsoft 365 admin center > Users > Active users > user > Licenses and Apps > Licenses.
claims.quote: In the admin center, go to the **Users** > [Active users] ... Select the row of the user ... In the right pane, select **Licenses and Apps**. ... Expand the **Licenses** section, select the boxes for the licenses that you want to assign

claims.claim: Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @() assigns a licence to a user.
claims.quote:
To assign a license to a user, use the following command in PowerShell.
Set-MgUserLicense -UserId $userUPN -AddLicenses @{SkuId = "<SkuId>"} -RemoveLicenses @()

claims.claim: Assigning licences requires at least License Administrator or User Administrator.
claims.quote: You must be at least a License or User Administrator to assign licenses.

claims.claim: The licence row controls licence assignment rather than directly switching notifications on or off.
claims.quote: When you use the **Active users** page to assign or unassign licenses, you assign or unassign users licenses to products.

claims.claim: The general Copilot settings page is at Microsoft 365 admin center > Copilot > Settings.
claims.quote: In the left navigation, expand **Copilot**, and then select **Settings**.

claims.claim: The Copilot settings page groups settings under User access, Data access, Copilot actions and Other settings.
claims.quote: Browse **User access**, **Data access**, **Copilot actions**, and **Other settings**.
